title: plugin-security: the permission-set projection and the position write-through delete metadata by name with no package — after #23165 a name two packages hold answers 409, and `storedRowPackageArg` (#21861) is redundant
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a reachable defect a sibling change exposes**. `reach:` `plugin-security`'s in-process callers of the metadata delete door, read from source at PR #23290's head (#23165's fix). Dev report `6148282605` on #23165, out-of-scope finding 2, which names the carrier as "the plugin-security lane". Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/plugins/plugin-security` is `domain:services`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at #23165's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What changes when PR #23290 lands

- #23165 makes a package-less delete resolve the one package the item is bound to, and refuse `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` when two or more packages hold the name. Before, it silently removed the first row in storage order.
- `plugin-security`'s `permission-set-projection.ts` and `position-write-through.ts` delete by name with no package. For a name two packages hold, they now get the 409, where they used to remove one row silently, possibly the wrong one. Their four suites are green at that head (110 tests), so no in-tree test holds the two-package case.
- `storedRowPackageArg` (#21861, the write-through's update leg naming its row's package) becomes redundant for a single-bound item, because the doors now resolve it.

## Wanted

- The two in-process deletes name the package of the row they mean, as `deletePackage` and the draft discards do on that head. A two-package name is then never ambiguous for them.
- `storedRowPackageArg` is kept, if it still names something the door cannot resolve, or retired, if it is redundant, with the measurement either way.
- Pins: a permission set and a position whose name two packages hold are each deleted from the intended package's row only.

Order: after PR #23290 lands.

## Also: the runtime's flow registration door

Added at PR #23290's contract review (`6148691041`, items ①.11 and OOS2), which found a third in-process writer the dev report did not name.

- `registerAndSaveFlow` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` saves a `flow` with no package and no `source`. For a one-package flow it now writes that package's row. For a name two packages hold it gets the 409, relays it, and rolls the engine registration back. The review calls that refusal correct: it is loud where the old write was silently misaddressed.
- Wanted, for this door: it names the package of the flow it registers whenever its caller has one, and a pin holds the two-package case either way (refused loudly, or written to the named package's row only).
- `packages/runtime` is `domain:cli`, not `domain:services`. Triage may split this door off into its own card; the seat lists it here so the family is complete in one place.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `permission-set-projection position-write-through delete metadata by name no package storedRowPackageArg` → 10 hits. #21861 and #21860 (closed) are the write-through's earlier package-axis defects; none is this.

Dedupe words: permission-set-projection delete by name no package; registerAndSaveFlow flow save no package 409; position-write-through delete 409 two packages; storedRowPackageArg redundant.
